name: Ship.com
description:
Ship.com is shipping and order management for online sellers and direct-sales consultants. Connect your account and Claude works from the same orders, rates, customers, and postage balance you see when you log in.

What Claude can do once connected:

- Orders: see what's ready to ship, read an order with its items and address, create an order for a sale from somewhere else, correct an address before you buy a label, cancel an order.
- Rates: quote USPS and UPS rates for an order or any package and compare the options, so you can buy the one you want on Ship.com.
- Labels: pull the label and tracking number for anything you've purchased. Canceling a label queues the refund rather than returning it instantly.
- Pickups: check which dates a carrier can collect, schedule a free pickup for labels you've printed, and review or cancel one.
- Tracking: check where any shipment stands.
- Customers: look up a contact and their order history, add or update one, and find who hasn't ordered in a while.
- Reports and analytics: yearly shipping and tax totals, plus volume, carrier mix, top destinations, and sales channels for any date range.
- Email: queue a message to one customer, or preview a marketing send, exact recipient count included, before it goes out.
- Addresses: validate and standardize a U.S. address against USPS.
- Account: postage balance, plan details, connected sales channels, product list, and an order sync from Shopify or Etsy.

Label purchasing itself happens on Ship.com, not in Claude. Claude preps everything up to that point: the ready queue, the address check, the rate comparison, and the label and tracking afterward.

Anything that goes out to a customer previews first. An email send shows exactly who it will reach and waits for your explicit go-ahead. Claude never sends on its own.

Requires a Ship.com account. What Claude can reach mirrors your plan: business reports need a reporting plan.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Ship.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Ship.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.ship.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Ship.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ship.com lists 37 MCP tools, including bulk_create_orders, cancel_order, cancel_pickup, cancel_shipping_label, check_pickup_availability, create_or_update_customer, create_order, get_balance, get_batch_status, get_customer, get_label, and get_order.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Ship.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Ship.com in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Ship.com requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Ship.com is developed by Ship.com. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
